basis: Marten’s July 19 earnings release was the earliest qualifying issuer communication located. Its consolidated statement of operations reports operating revenue, including fuel surcharges, of $285,672,000 for the three months ended June 30, 2023, versus $329,565,000 for the same quarter in 2022. Revenue fell 13.32% year over year and was below the $313,086,750 threshold.

coverage.detail: January 24, preceding earnings cycle. The release reported Q4 and full-year 2022 results. Management discussed organic growth without giving a numeric Q2 2023 consolidated revenue outlook.
The accompanying investor presentation compared historical revenue through Q4 2022. It gave no Q2 2023 consolidated revenue bound.

April 18, immediately preceding earnings release. Q1 operating revenue rose 3.7% to $298.0 million. The chairman described a softer freight market and expected more carriers to exit, without quantifying Marten’s Q2 revenue.
The April investor presentation showed quarterly revenue changes through Q1 2023. Its $225 million estimate covered 2023 net capital expenditures. It gave no Q2 revenue forecast.
The May 5 Form 10-Q covered the quarter ended March 31. Its discussion of operating results and capital spending supplied no numeric Q2 consolidated revenue guidance.
The May 8 Form 8-K reported compensation decisions and voting results from the May 2 annual meeting. It contained no Q2 revenue update.

The issuer’s press archive lists no release between April 18 and July 19. A separate live search of the interval found Marten’s May 2 dividend announcement ($0.06 per share) and no preliminary results, revised guidance, or dated public management call or conference remarks establishing a Q2 revenue ceiling.

July 19 actuals. The issuer-hosted release confirms the operating revenue row of 285,672 versus 329,565 in thousands under the three-month columns. The six-month figures and revenue excluding fuel surcharges are separately identified.
Item 2.02 confirms the company issued its June-quarter results on July 19. The same filing furnished the earnings release and investor slides.

publication_date_evidence: Exhibit 99.1 carries the July 19, 2023 GlobeNewswire dateline. Marten independently identifies July 19 as the press release issuance date in Item 2.02 of its Form 8-K.
